title: On Busemann subgradient methods for stochastic minimization in Hadamard spaces
summary: We study the recently introduced Busemann subgradient method due to Goodwin, Lewis, López-Acedo and Nicolae, extending it to minimize the mean of a stochastic function over general Hadamard spaces. We prove a strong convergence theorem under a local compactness assumption and further prove weak convergence of the method over separable Hadamard spaces.
